einzeiler: Andy Cohen interviews John Mayer at Stephen Talkhouse about his upcoming album and life.
kurzfassung: Andy Cohen sits down with John Mayer at Stephen Talkhouse in the Hamptons for an exclusive conversation. Mayer discusses the creative process behind his upcoming album, which he is currently mixing in Cohen's bedroom. He also reflects on his time with Dead & Company, the legacy of Dolly Parton, and why he rarely feels lonely.
stichpunkte: John Mayer is currently mixing the lead single for his upcoming album right from Andy Cohen's bedroom.
The new record features a stripped-down, direct vocal style that aims to connect intimately with listeners.
Mayer reflects on his grieving process after the end of Dead & Company and the lasting lessons he learned from Bob Weir.
He shares his perspective on the universal outpouring of grief following the passing of Dolly Parton.
Despite being single, Mayer rarely feels lonely due to how easily he can keep himself occupied.
He opens up about the vulnerability of aging and why he posts less on Instagram as he gets older.
Mayer explains how his SiriusXM channel reflects his lifelong habit of taking creative projects to their absolute limits.

clips.hook: We are in the last sliver of time before the new record.
clips.text: The release of the upcoming album is just a matter of weeks away, marking the end of the long wait since the previous record.

clips.hook: You don't have to overthink it so much. You just take the songs for a walk.
clips.text: The most valuable takeaway from working with Bob Weir is learning to stop overthinking and let the music happen naturally.

clips.hook: The world came together on the day of Dolly Parton's passing.
clips.text: The universal loss of Dolly Parton briefly united a fractured world in a shared expression of love and connection.

clips.hook: We never hit rock bottom of loneliness because there is so much stuff to do.
clips.text: Modern distractions and busy schedules prevent people from fully experiencing and confronting their solitude.

clips.hook: I am learning to see my older face and accept that's you now.
clips.text: Coming to terms with physical aging plays a major role in why older artists post less frequently on social media.

This was an exclusive invite but that doesn't mean that you're left out! I got to interview my other (platonic) fella, John Mayer, before he took the stage at Stephen Talkhouse in the Hamptons.
